name: Test Runner
description: Runs the project's Python unit tests so the agent can check its own changes.

permissions.reason: Run python3 -m unittest in your project. Helm runs it in a sandbox limited to the project, with no network access.
The tests need to read your project's code.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run the project's Python unit tests (python3 -m unittest discover) and report which tests passed and failed, with failure details. Use it after changing code to check your work. Pass `pattern` to run only matching tests.

pattern.description: Only run tests whose name contains this, e.g. test_units or PassageTest.

panels.title: Tests
panels.description: Result of the last test run.

timeoutSeconds.description: Stop a test run that takes longer than this.
